verdicts.reason: Both drop the original concept, where the quote sat inside a frame surrounded by illustrations. Each shrinks the illustration into a small thumbnail below the text, and that thumbnail shows a stock 'BEAUTY ILLUSTRATION / HAND DRAWN ELEMENTS' label that was not in the original, so fidelity is broken. The quote is stacked into an eight-line column with no frame. A's lines 'BECAUSE' and 'MAKEUP.' run almost to the canvas edges with no side margin. B keeps slightly more breathing room on the sides but leaves 'JUST' alone on its own line; otherwise the two are near-identical, with the attribution isolated at the bottom.
